company.name: Power Grid Corporation of India
company.tag: The network between generators and users
company.summary: High-voltage transmission infrastructure that moves electricity across regions.
company.description: POWERGRID builds, owns and operates electricity transmission networks. It carries power over high-voltage lines and substations and also provides telecom and consultancy services.
company.money: The company earns regulated transmission charges and income from related services. Network availability, approved returns, capital projects, borrowing costs and collections influence performance.
company.ownership: This profile covers Power Grid Corporation of India Limited. It is a transmission company; electricity generation and household distribution are generally performed by other entities.
watch: Are new transmission projects entering service on schedule?
Is the system meeting required operating performance?
How do approved returns and borrowing costs affect new investment?
risks: Land, approvals and construction issues can postpone revenue.
Changes in tariff rules can affect project economics.
A large infrastructure programme creates financing and execution risk.
update: POWERGRID mainly moves electricity through its network. It should be analysed differently from a company that produces electricity.
company.question: Does POWERGRID earn money mainly by selling electricity it generates?
company.answer: No. Its central business is transmitting electricity through its network and earning transmission charges; generators produce the power.
